name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: A text input that filters a list of options as people type, for picking from long lists.

examples.name: combobox-demo
examples.title: Combobox
examples.description: Filter a long list of countries by typing.

examples.name: combobox-custom-value
examples.title: Custom value
examples.description: allowsCustomValue keeps text that isn't in the list.

examples.name: combobox-with-sections
examples.title: Sections, icons and descriptions
examples.description: Group options under headings; items can have an icon and a second line.

examples.name: combobox-invalid
examples.title: Invalid and disabled
examples.description: Required with an error message, and a disabled combobox.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Use aria-label only when a visible label is impossible.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the input, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the input when the field is invalid.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text in the input.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Row shown when nothing matches the typed text.

props.name: items / defaultItems
props.description: Items for a dynamic list. Use defaultItems to let the combobox filter them; items when you filter yourself.

props.name: children
props.description: ComboboxItem and ComboboxSection elements, or a function that renders one per item.

props.name: selectedKey / defaultSelectedKey
props.description: The selected item's id, controlled or initial.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when an option is chosen or the selection is cleared.

props.name: inputValue / defaultInputValue
props.description: The text in the input, controlled or initial.

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: Called as the text changes.

props.name: allowsCustomValue
props.description: Keep typed text that doesn't match an option instead of reverting on blur.

props.name: menuTrigger
props.description: What opens the list: typing, focusing, or only the button and arrow keys.

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: Custom filter for defaultItems. Defaults to a locale-aware 'contains'.

props.name: allowsEmptyCollection
props.description: Keep the list open to show emptyState when nothing matches.

props.name: isRequired / isInvalid / isDisabled
props.description: Field states; isRequired also shows the label's required marker.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique key used by selectedKey and onSelectionChange.

props.name: children
props.description: The option label. A string also becomes its textValue, which fills the input when chosen.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Plain text used for filtering and the input when children is not a string.

props.name: description
props.description: A second, quieter line under the label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative leading icon.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading for the group; also its accessible name. Sections with no matches hide while filtering.

keyboard.action: Filters the list and opens it.
Opens the list; moves the highlighted option while focus stays in the input.
Chooses the highlighted option and closes the list.
Closes the list and puts back the text of the selected option (typed text is kept with allowsCustomValue).
Commits the current text or selection and moves focus on.

notes: The input is role="combobox" with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant; the highlighted option is announced as you arrow.
The chevron button is for pointer users and is excluded from the tab order.
The empty state is rendered inside the listbox so screen readers announce it.

do: Use for long lists (15+ options) people know by name: countries, people, accounts.
Write a placeholder that says what can be searched.
Use allowsCustomValue only when free text is a valid answer.
dont: Don't use for short lists — a Select is quicker to scan.
Don't use for search that navigates or runs actions — use SearchField or Command.
Don't hide the label behind the placeholder.
